description: This is an HTML source file that provides a web-based user interface for visualizing databases and their tables. It includes embedded CSS for styling, JavaScript for dynamic interactions such as fetching database and table data, and DOM manipulation for rendering table data and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, clearing current selection.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a specific database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a specific table in a selected database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table from data fetched from the server.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full or truncated content.
